name: blob_list
title: stores.blob_list
lead: Lists a player's blobs across all blob stores in this scope, each with its store, key, version and size.
signature: stores.blob_list(owner: string) → {{store: string, key: string, version: number, size: number }}
returns: {{store: string , key: string , version: number , size: number }}

usedIn.quote: - `stores.blob_list(player_uuid)` returns entries across all blob stores in this scope.
